en.name: JSON Formatter
en.short: Format, minify and validate JSON with every error marked.
en.title: JSON Formatter & Validator online
en.description: Format, beautify, minify and validate JSON online. Every error is underlined at its exact line and column, with a collapsible tree view. 100% in your browser.
en.lead: Paste your JSON: it is validated and formatted as you type, with every error underlined.
en.placeholder: Paste or drop a JSON file here…
en.invalid: {count, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} found

errors.InvalidSymbol: Unexpected symbol. Strings need double quotes and keys must be quoted.
errors.InvalidNumberFormat: Invalid number format (no leading zeros, hex, NaN or Infinity in JSON).
errors.PropertyNameExpected: A property name in double quotes was expected (maybe a trailing comma?).
errors.ValueExpected: A value was expected here (maybe a trailing comma or a missing value?).
errors.ColonExpected: A colon (:) was expected after the property name.
errors.CommaExpected: A comma is missing between these elements.
errors.CloseBraceExpected: An object is not closed: a closing brace } is missing.
errors.CloseBracketExpected: An array is not closed: a closing bracket ] is missing.
errors.EndOfFileExpected: Extra content after the end of the JSON value.
errors.InvalidCommentToken: Comments are not allowed in JSON.
errors.UnexpectedEndOfString: A string is not closed: a closing double quote is missing.
errors.InvalidUnicode: Invalid unicode escape (use \uXXXX with 4 hex digits).
errors.InvalidEscapeCharacter: Invalid escape sequence inside a string.
errors.InvalidCharacter: Invalid character (control characters must be escaped inside strings).
